### Section 2: Error & Rescue Map

Codepaths are the ones any implementation of the accepted set must have; names are placeholders, not prescribed contracts.

```
  METHOD/CODEPATH               | WHAT CAN GO WRONG                          | EXCEPTION CLASS (placeholder)
  ------------------------------|--------------------------------------------|------------------------------
  SlackAlertSender#deliver (E1) | token revoked / app uninstalled            | SlackAuthError (token_revoked, account_inactive)
                                | DM target user not in workspace / deactivated | SlackUserNotFound (user_not_found, users_not_found)
                                | rate limited                               | SlackRateLimited (429 + Retry-After)
                                | message too long (>40k chars) / blocks > 50 | SlackInvalidPayload (msg_too_long, invalid_blocks)
                                | network timeout                            | TimeoutError
                                | missing im:write scope on existing token   | SlackMissingScope (missing_scope)
  TeamsAlertSender#deliver (E3) | client secret expired / app consent revoked | TeamsAuthError (401 invalid_client)
                                | webhook URL deleted by tenant admin        | TeamsWebhookGone (404/410)
                                | throttled                                  | TeamsThrottled (429)
                                | adaptive card schema rejected              | TeamsInvalidCard (400)
                                | tenant blocks custom apps                  | TeamsInstallBlocked (403 at install)
                                | network timeout                            | TimeoutError
  TelegramAlertSender#deliver   | bot blocked by user / chat deleted         | TelegramForbidden (403)
  (E4)                          | chat_id unknown                            | TelegramBadRequest (400 chat not found)
                                | rate limited                               | TelegramRateLimited (429 retry_after)
                                | message > 4096 chars                       | TelegramMessageTooLong (400)
                                | network timeout                            | TimeoutError
  Inbound callback handlers     | signature/JWT invalid                      | SignatureInvalid (all three)
  (E1 events, E3 bot, E4 webhook)| replayed request                          | ReplayDetected
                                | malformed body                             | JSONParseError
  Alert event construction      | incident has no destination configured     | NoDestinationConfigured
  (shared by nature, P1)        | incident title/body empty                  | EmptyAlertContent
  ------------------------------|--------------------------------------------|------------------------------

  EXCEPTION CLASS          | RESCUED? (per PLAN.md) | RESCUE ACTION (required if D3=A)             | USER SEES
  -------------------------|------------------------|----------------------------------------------|---------------------------
  *RateLimited (all)       | unspecified ← GAP      | honor Retry-After, backoff, max N, then dead-letter | nothing if retry succeeds; dead-letter alert if not
  TimeoutError (all)       | unspecified ← GAP      | retry 2x with jitter, then dead-letter          | same
  *AuthError (all)         | unspecified ← GAP      | no retry; mark integration unhealthy; notify workspace owner + ops | banner "Slack/Teams alerts disconnected, reconnect"
  SlackUserNotFound        | unspecified ← GAP      | no retry; fall back to channel or ops; log with user id | ops sees "recipient gone"
  TelegramForbidden        | unspecified ← GAP      | mark chat dead; stop sending; surface in settings | "Telegram destination blocked the bot"
  TeamsWebhookGone         | unspecified ← GAP      | mark destination dead; notify owner              | "Teams webhook removed, re-add"
  *InvalidPayload/Card/TooLong | unspecified ← GAP  | truncate + retry once with plain fallback; log full payload hash | alert arrives in reduced form
  SignatureInvalid         | unspecified ← GAP      | reject 401, log source IP + platform, count metric | nothing (attacker gets 401)
  ReplayDetected           | unspecified ← GAP      | reject, log                                      | nothing
  JSONParseError (inbound) | unspecified ← GAP      | reject 400, log body hash                        | nothing
  NoDestinationConfigured  | unspecified ← GAP      | do not silently skip: log at warn, count metric, show in incident timeline | "alert not sent: no Slack destination"
  EmptyAlertContent        | unspecified ← GAP      | render fallback text with incident id            | alert with generic title
```

Every row is a GAP because PLAN.md specifies build cost and demand only; it names no failure behavior. That is expected at prioritization depth. What is not acceptable at any depth: an incident-alerting feature whose delivery failures are invisible. The rows marked `*AuthError`, `TelegramForbidden`, `TeamsWebhookGone` and `NoDestinationConfigured` are the silent-failure cases: the platform says no, and nobody who cares is told.

Rules check: no catch-alls proposed; every rescue above names the class. Retry-then-dead-letter is the only "swallow" and it is not silent.

Findings:
- **CRITICAL GAP** (S2-a, = S1-b, ledger P5) Delivery failure visibility is unspecified for all three accepted integrations. Decision D3 below.
- **WARNING** (S2-b) Inbound signature verification is unspecified; Section 3 owns it.
- **WARNING** (S2-c) NoDestinationConfigured is the most likely day-1 silent failure (incident fires before anyone connected a workspace). Covered by D3 if A.

Decision gate: Resolve S2-a now via 0D (row P5).
